# 4 Ezra Chapter 16 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 6th Ezra (Christian addition) — Conclusion

---

**1** Woe to you, Babylon, and Asia! Woe to you, Egypt, and Syria!

**2** Gird yourselves with sackcloth and cloth of goats' hair, and bewail your children, and lament; for your destruction is at hand.

**3** A sword is sent upon you, and who is there to turn it back?

**4** A fire is sent upon you, and who is there to quench it?

**5** Calamities are sent upon you, and who is there to drive them away?

**6** Can one drive away a hungry lion in the forest, or quench a fire in straw when it has once begun to burn?

**7** Can one turn back the arrow that is shot by a strong archer?

**8** The LORD God sends calamities, and who shall drive them away?

**9** A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is there to quench it?

**10** He shall cast lightning, and who shall not fear? He shall thunder, and who shall not tremble?

**11** The LORD shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly shattered at his presence?

**12** The earth quakes and her foundations; the sea rises up with waves from the deep, and its waves are troubled, and the fish thereof also, before the LORD and before the glory of his power:

**13** for strong is his right hand that bends the bow, and his arrows that he shoots are sharp and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.

**14** Behold! the calamities are sent and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.

**15** The fire is kindled and shall not be put out, until it consumes the foundations of the earth.

**16** Like as an arrow shot by a mighty archer returns not back, so the calamities that are sent upon the earth shall not return again.

**17** Woe is me! Woe is me! Who will deliver me in those days?

**18** The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! What shall I do when these evils shall come?

**19** Behold famine and plague, and tribulation and anguish: they are sent as scourges for amendment.

**20** But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.

**21** Behold, food shall be so cheap upon the earth that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall calamities grow upon the earth — sword, famine, and great confusion.

**22** For many of those who dwell upon the earth shall perish of famine; and the others that escape the famine shall the sword destroy.

**23** And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them; for the earth shall be left desolate, and her cities shall be cast down.

**24** There shall be no man left to till the earth and to sow it.

**25** The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?

**26** The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men.

**27** So that one man shall desire to see another, or even to hear his voice.

**28** For of a city ten shall be left, and of the field two, who have hidden themselves in the thick groves and the clefts of the rocks.

**29** As in an olive garden three or four olives are left on every tree,

**30** or as when a vineyard is gathered there are left some clusters by those who diligently search through the vineyard:

**31** so in those days three or four shall be left by those who search their houses with the sword.

**32** And the earth shall be left waste, and the fields thereof shall wither, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel through them.

**33** The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, for they shall have no helpers.

**34** Their bridegrooms shall be killed in the wars; and their husbands shall perish of famine.

**35** Hear now these things and understand them, you servants of the LORD.

**36** Behold the word of the LORD, receive it; believe not the gods of whom the LORD spoke.

**37** Behold, the calamities draw nigh and are not slack.

**38** As when a woman with child in the ninth month brings forth her son — with two or three hours of her labor there will be great pain about her womb — and when the child comes forth from the womb there will not be a moment's delay:

**39** so shall the calamities not be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall take hold of it on every side.

**40** O my people, hear my word: make ready for the battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.

**41** He that sells, let him be as he that flees away; and he that buys, as one that loses his goods;

**42** he that occupies merchandise, as he that has no profit by it; and he that builds, as he that shall not dwell therein:

**43** he that sows, as if he shall not reap; so also he that prunes the vines, as if he shall not gather the grapes:

**44** they that marry, as they who shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowed.

**45** In this regard therefore all that labor, labor in vain;

**46** for strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captive; for in captivity and famine shall they beget their children.

**47** And they that trade do it with robbery: the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their persons,

**48** the more will I be angry with them for their sins, says the LORD.

**49** As a whore envies a right honest and beautiful woman,

**50** so shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decks herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he comes who defends him who diligently searches out every sin upon earth.

**51** Therefore be not like her, neither like her works.

**52** For yet a little while, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign over you.

**53** Let not the sinner say that he has not sinned; for God shall burn coals of fire upon his head, who says before the LORD God and his glory: I have not sinned.

**54** Behold, the LORD knows all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts.

**55** He said in the beginning: Let the earth be made; and it was made; and: Let the heaven be made; and it was made.

**56** And by his word were the stars fixed, and he knows the number of the stars.

**57** Who searches the deep and its treasures? Who has measured the sea and its content?

**58** Who has shut up the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word has suspended it?

**59** Who has spread out the heaven like a vault; and who has established it upon the waters?

**60** Who has made fountains of water in the desert, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, to send out rivers from the high places to water the earth?

**61** Who has formed man, and put a heart in the midst of the body, and given him breath, life, and understanding?

**62** Yea, and who has made the fire and sent it down from the heaven, that it might come upon all things that were made, at his commandment?

**63** Who has formed the earth? He that governs it.

**64** Who holds the sea? He that brings it to rest.

**65** Who holds the whole earth from the beginning to the end? He that holds all things in his hands.

**66** Thus says the LORD: Do you not know that he is God who made all these things?

**67** For this reason the LORD sees all that any man does, and knows all that man thinks to do;

**68** and he shall bring them all to judgment, even their works and their thoughts.

**69** And he shall search Jerusalem and all the cities of Israel, as a man goes through a house with a candle.

**70** And he shall examine all their secrets, and he shall make them manifest before all men.

**71** Woe to the sinners who make an effort to hide their sins! For the LORD shall strictly examine all their works and bring them all to shame.

**72** And they that fear the LORD shall not fear nor tremble before him; for they know that, though they have sinned, they have done right.

**73** Hear therefore, you nations, and know whom we serve.

**74** Serve him not with other gods, but serve the LORD alone; that you may escape such tribulation as has just been described.

**75** Besides all this, understand, you that are called by the name of the LORD.

**76** You that remain, be steadfast in your faith; for you know that your reward is beyond all measure.

**77** And rejoice in the prosperity of the righteous, though you yourselves are not righteous.

**78** For this is the end which the LORD has appointed for you.
